groups.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. The input is a production embroidery atlas, not a request to redraw it. Remove ONLY the exposed beige/cream linen substrate and its photographic paper/fabric colour/texture. Output the coloured embroidered threadwork on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Preserve all existing subjects, wool outlines and flat thread fills, pale stitched areas that belong to people/machines, ground/water strokes, animal dividers, and every object's exact placement and proportions. Holes between thread contours should be transparent linen; retain unfilled profile faces as transparent where they were exposed fabric. Do not replace, recolour, distort or invent figures. No added limb, new text, new border, glow, drop shadow, checkerboard pixels or solid backdrop. Keep the COMPLETE original 2172x724 atlas canvas and four source bands at the SAME coordinates; no tightening, trimming, cropping, scaling, reflow or repacking. This will be drawn over one continuous linen texture in the app, so retain the actual stitched threads, not rectangular chunks of their linen ground. Keep all source row boundaries exactly. Preserve the comet and observers in the bottom row where present.
